# Eqskavatori.ge

> Mini excavator services with an operator in Tbilisi, Georgia (and surroundings): earthworks, trench digging, foundation excavation, septic tank installation, sewer and water line installation, site levelling, hydraulic breaker (concrete breaking), post hole drilling (auger), demolition, landscaping and construction debris removal with our own truck. The machine always comes with our operator. Prices are agreed in advance by phone/WhatsApp (they depend on the job). Languages: Georgian, English, Russian.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +995514908090 (514 90 80 90) — https://wa.me/995514908090
- Email: info@eqskavatori.ge
- Area: Tbilisi and surroundings; further by agreement
